Look what's happened to him!|audio = Null&VoidN1Wave11-1.ogg|[[Commander (Narrator)|Commander]] on Wave 11 ([[Outpost 16]])}} }} ==Description== The '''Null Freezer''', internally referred to as '''Corrupted Freezer''', was a support enemy that appeared in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] as part of the [[Null & Void Event]]. It had a decent amount of health and a rather fast speed. The '''Null Freezer''' had one ability where it throws a neon blue snowball at a tower or a unit in its range of 20. This will freeze any tower for 2 seconds or damage units by 400 if hit by its small explosion. ==Logbook Description== "''The [[Nil Zone]]'s creatures defy all logic. When the [[God Cube|God Shard]] experiment failed, the fabric that separated the [[Nil Zone]] tore, allowing it to replicate the [[Overworld]]. Creatures morphed into [[Freezer]]s with the ability to stun any tower they fired upon. For the original [[Freezer]], it was like staring into a corrupted mirror.''" ==Appearance== The '''Null Freezer''' is a corrupted recreation of the [[Freezer]]. It has purple skin. It wears a purple shirt, pants, beanie and shoes. It has purple fur around its neck and a bag on its back. Tendrils can be seen coming out of its bag and around its head. It also has knee-pads and a small plate on its left arm. What appears to be purple goo can be seen on its hands and feet. In its hands, it carries a neon blue snowball which it throws at towers and units. ==Event Strategy== As this enemy only appears through [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode, no strategy section is made for its current version. Instead, a strategy section for the one that appeared without [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode in [[Outpost 16]], [[Banlands]] and [[Blind Faith]] is listed instead. *Towers with decent DPS like the [[Golden Scout]], [[Rocketeer]], [[Minigunner]] and [[Accelerator]] are quite decent against the '''Null Freezer'''. **Towers which are placed multiple times are especially useful here, as the explosion is quite small. This means only one tower or unit will be hit on average, which hurts low placement towers like [[Turret]] or [[Gatling Gun]] far more. *As the '''Null Freezer''' freezes towers, towers immune to stuns are not immune to its freeze. **While the [[Pursuit]] does have the [[Freeze Immunity]], it does not work and it still gets frozen regardless. *Units that do not stop moving are quite effective against the '''Null Freezer''' due to its horrible aim. As it will aim at where it stood originally, it will miss any moving unit, making them basically immune to its attack. **This makes towers like the [[Mercenary Base]], [[Military Base]] and [[Necromancer]] useful against it. **Units that stop to move or are stationary however, are pretty ineffective as they will always be hit by it. Such units include the [[Rifleman]], [[Biologist]] plants and [[Crook Boss]] goons, though as a lot of them will be spread out rather than stacked in one place, only one will be hit generally. **Interestingly, It will also target units still in their death animation as long as the actual model has not disappeared yet. ==Gallery== {{Gallery| {{GalleryHeader|Corpse Variants}} CorpseFreezer.png|Second [[Corpse (Enemy)|Corpse]] variant, current version (18 October 2025 – Present) {{GalleryHeader|Promotional Videos}} Tower Defense Simulator - Halloween 2025 Trailer|'''Null Freezer''' on a promotional video. {{GalleryHeader|Miscellaneous}} DefaultEnemyIconIG.png|'''Null Freezer''' on its bugged [[Index]] icon. NullFreezerIconIG.png|'''Null Freezer''' on its [[Index]] icon. }} ==Trivia== *While the '''Null Freezer''' can actually hit multiple towers or enemies at once, this is extremely unlikely to happen as its size means the units or towers basically have to be standing in one spot. *The '''Null Freezer''' is unaffected by enemy appearance [[modifiers]], such as [[Talk Like a Pirate Day]]. ==Update History== *'''18 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0]] **'''Null Freezer''' added. **{{Bug}} '''Null Freezer''' has a broken icon. **{{Bug}} '''Null Freezer''' is positioned sideways in the [[Index]]. *'''19 October 2025''' - [[v1.77.0|v1.77.3a]] **[[Logbooks|Logbook]] description added. *'''25 October 2025''' - [[v1.78.0]] **Now appears in [[Banlands]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Freezer''' is now properly positioned in the [[Index]]. *'''31 October 2025''' - [[v1.79.0]] **Now appears in [[Blind Faith]]. **{{Bugfix}} '''Null Freezer''' now uses its correct icon. *'''26 November 2025''' - [[v1.80.0|v1.80.1e]] **'''Null Freezer''' removed from the main game, now appears exclusively in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''3 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]] **{{Bug}} Cannot be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. *'''4 December 2025''' - [[v1.82.0]]b ** {{Bugfix}} Can now be spawned in [[Sandbox Mode|Sandbox]] mode. {{Outpost16|[[Lost Glitch]]|Wave 9|Null Freezer|Wave 11|[[Null Beast]]|Wave 13}} {{Banlands|[[Null Crook Boss]]|Wave 10|Null Freezer|Wave 12|[[Null Medic]]|Wave 15}} {{BlindFaith|[[Null Goon]]|Wave 5 (Easy)
